title: Ratios
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:38Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No point in the bank covers simplifying ratios or sharing a quantity in a given ratio; the trigonometric and common-ratio points use the word ratio for different ideas.

draft.title: Ratios
card: A ratio compares quantities of the same kind in the same unit. Simplify it by dividing every part by the same number, as with fractions. For example, 12 : 18 = 2 : 3 after dividing by 6.
If the units differ, change them to the same unit first. 50 cm to 2 m becomes 50 : 200, which simplifies to 1 : 4.
To share a quantity in a ratio, add the parts to get the total number of parts. Divide the quantity by this total to find the value of one part.
Multiply one part by each ratio number. Sharing $600 in the ratio 2 : 3 gives 2 + 3 = 5 parts. One part is $600 ÷ 5 = $120, so the shares are $240 and $360.
draft.remember: Add the parts, divide to find one part, then multiply by each ratio number.

a.q: Ava and Ben share $450 in the ratio 4 : 5. How much does Ben get?
a.why: There are 4 + 5 = 9 parts, so one part is $450 ÷ 9 = $50. Ben gets 5 × $50 = $250. $200 is Ava's share, and it is the tempting wrong option.
a.clue: Add the parts first, then find one part.

b.q: Mia mixes 750 mL of cordial with 3 L of water. What is the ratio of cordial to water in simplest form?
b.why: Change 3 L to 3000 mL. The ratio 750 : 3000 simplifies by dividing both by 750 to give 1 : 4. Writing 750 : 3 and simplifying to 250 : 1 is wrong because the units were not the same.
b.clue: Put both amounts in the same unit before simplifying.
